title: The Common Route - Visual Novel Music Pack, Slice of Life BGM in Major and Minor - 44 Tracks
tagline: 44 track slice of life visual novel score: six tunes in major and minor, the piano in every track. MIDI + OGG, loops.
description:
The Common Route is a 44 track slice of life visual novel music pack: 38 full looping pieces and 6 short cues for scene changes, 48:37 of music, as OGG files with sample accurate loop tags plus all 44 editable MIDI sources. RPG Maker MV and MZ read the loop points with no plugin, and the Readme gives the import steps for Godot 4 (followed in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files), Unity and GameMaker. Royalty free for commercial games. Three full tracks are free to download on this page, with their MIDI.

One summer on a visual novel's common route. The opening: "The Common Route". Ordinary days: "Morning Light", "Wake Up, You're Late!", "The Walk to School", "Homeroom", "Lunch on the Roof", "The Club Room", "The Shopping Street", "Our Usual Café", "Seaside Town", "Dinner at Home", "Night, My Room" and "The Library After Hours". Summer: "The Beach in July", "The Summer Festival", "Her Theme", "Total Chaos", "A Brilliant Plan", "Awkward Silence" and "The Last Train". The turn: "Something She Isn't Saying", "Morning Light, Alone", "The Walk Home in the Rain", "The Empty Classroom", "The Argument", "Running After Her", "Closed for the Season", "After the Fireworks", "Heart to Heart", "The Music Box", "Her Theme, Remembered", "Resolve", "The Confession" and "Goodbye at the Station". The endings: "Good End", "Bad End", "Epilogue: Next Spring" and "The Common Route (Credits)". Cues: "Eyecatch", "Scene Change", "Comic Sting", "A Sudden Gasp", "Chapter End" and "The End?".

Mood pairs. Six tunes come twice, once in a major key and once in its parallel minor on the same key note, at another tempo with another pad and second line under the same lead: "Morning Light" with "Morning Light, Alone"; "The Walk to School" with "The Walk Home in the Rain"; "Homeroom" with "The Empty Classroom"; "Our Usual Café" with "Closed for the Season"; "The Summer Festival" with "After the Fireworks"; "Her Theme" with "Her Theme, Remembered". In each pair the lead plays the same rhythm and the same scale degree note for note, 628 lead notes measured in the shipped MIDI. The minor version lowers the third, sixth and seventh (258 notes) and keeps the seventh raised over its major dominant chord (22 notes), so a scene that turns sad can keep its tune.

The royal road. Every one of the 15 major key full pieces moves IV7, V7, iii7, vi7 in its second half, the progression Japanese pop songwriting calls the royal road (in C major: Fmaj7, G7, Em7, Am7). All four tones of each of those 60 chords sound in the accompaniment while it is declared, 60 of 60, measured. The six minor versions carry the same degrees in the minor key, 24 of 24 chords sounded.

One theme, one piano. The seed theme, Promise, climbs two thirds to the fifth and steps back down, and all 44 tracks state it in its own shape, counted by the harness in the finished MIDI. Four more themes come with it: Heart is the seed turned over, for the argument and the confession; Everyday runs in eighths, for ordinary days; Rain falls three steps and lifts, for night and goodbyes; Mischief jumps a fourth, for the comedy. The piano plays in all 44 tracks, leading 9 of them and playing the accompaniment, the counter line or the colour in the rest. 2,333 statements and fragments of the 5 themes across the album.

What is in it. 38 full pieces and 6 cues, 48:37 of music, 17 in ionian, 13 in aeolian, 5 in dorian, 5 in mixolydian and 4 in lydian, 36 keys, 60 to 152 BPM, all in 4/4. 29 General MIDI instruments, among them piano, electric piano, strings, flute, clarinet, oboe, harp, celesta, music box, nylon and steel guitar, vibraphone, marimba and accordion. Every pitched note is in its track's mode or is a tone of a chord the track declares: 17,102 notes read, none outside both.

What you get. 44 OGG files, 38 of them with sample accurate LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags, which is what RPG Maker MV and MZ read; each looping file ends exactly at its loop end. 44 editable .mid sources. A Readme with per engine import notes, the proof reports, and a royalty free commercial licence.

Gate results. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, and the reports ship inside the download. They say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks are for.

Three full tracks are free on this page, with their MIDI: "Her Theme" and "Her Theme, Remembered", a mood pair (the same lead in major and in minor), and "Total Chaos", the comedy beat.

An honest note. The renders are a General MIDI reference render through a conventional soundfont, and the instruments are the General MIDI sounds of those names; the MIDI is there so you can use your own. No game cue or song is quoted; every tune was composed for this record. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used anywhere.

devlog.title: The Common Route is out: a 44 track slice of life visual novel score with six tunes in major and minor
devlog.body:
The Common Route is a 44 track music pack for visual novels and story games: one school summer from the title screen to the endings, with mornings, homeroom, the roof at lunch, the café, the festival, the argument, the rain, the confession, a good end and a bad end, and six short cues for eyecatches and scene changes. It is live now, with three full tracks free to download from the page.

The idea. Six tunes come twice, in a major key and again in its parallel minor, with the lead identical in rhythm and scale degree (628 lead notes, measured in the shipped MIDI), so a scene that turns can keep its tune. Every major key full piece moves through the royal road progression IV7, V7, iii7, vi7 in its second half, all four tones of each chord sounded (60 of 60). The piano plays in all 44 tracks, and the seed theme is stated in its own shape in all 44.

How it was checked. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, with the reports inside the download. The loop tags were followed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files. Those numbers say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks ("Her Theme", "Her Theme, Remembered" and "Total Chaos") are for.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render; the MIDI is there so you can move it to your own sounds. No game cue or song is quoted. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used.
